title: 菊花賞の後に・エデンへ至るヒント

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's chillax strategy proves effective, and she delivers a performance for the ages! But what will stoke her competitive fire now?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as Gold Ship prepares to start a life working the land, Eishin Flash challenges her to a battle in the upcoming Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, she'll throw in a new clue from the Book of Secrets if Gold Ship accepts the challenge! It's a deal that can't be beat, and just like that, Gold Ship is back in action!
